pathologies.label: Stop codon in the variant
pathologies.why: The library was built with degenerate codons, which also encode stop. These are truncated proteins, not design candidates.

pathologies.label: Zero reads in the input library
pathologies.why: Seen after selection but never before it. Fitness would divide by zero.

pathologies.label: Fewer than 10 input reads
pathologies.why: Too few reads to estimate a ratio. One extra read changes the answer by tens of percent.

pathologies.label: Zero reads after selection (IGG20)
pathologies.why: Either genuinely dead, or present but missed by sequencing. The data cannot tell you which.
